name: Scholomance
summary: Beneath Caer Darrow, Scholomance trains mortals and undead in necromancy and the dark arts. Darkmaster Gandling leads the studies, while Ras Frostwhisper watches over the halls.

sections.title: A Pact of Ruin
sections.body:
Before the Third War, House Barov ruled from Caer Darrow and held vast lands across Lordaeron. Those lands included Brill, Tarren Mill, and Southshore. Fearing the loss of their wealth and mortal lives, the Barovs accepted Kel'Thuzad's promise of eternal life.

They deeded their fortress and ancestral catacombs to the Cult of the Damned. The cult repaid them by butchering the nobles and turning the crypts into a hidden place to train necromancers.

sections.title: The School of Necromancy
sections.body:
Beneath Caer Darrow's haunted ruins, Scholomance has become a center of Scourge industry. In its halls, early strains of the Plague of Undeath were tested on the Barov family's servants. Mortal acolytes now come to master dark magic under Darkmaster Gandling, while Ras Frostwhisper guards the school.

The Barov family remains as restless undead, trapped in torment.

faq.answer: Beneath Caer Darrow, Scholomance trains mortal necromancers, plague researchers, and fleshcrafters. The Cult of the Damned and the Scourge run the secret academy.

faq.q: Who owns Caer Darrow and the crypts?
faq.answer: House Barov once owned Caer Darrow's keep and crypts, along with vast lands across Lordaeron. Seeking immortality, the family surrendered their ancestral home to Kel'Thuzad, who promised them eternal life. The cult butchered the Barovs and raised them as undead thralls within their own halls.
Darkmaster Gandling runs Scholomance as its mortal headmaster, overseeing instruction and torment. The lich Ras Frostwhisper guards the academy on behalf of the Scourge.
The Cult of the Damned tested early strains of the Plague of Undeath at Scholomance. Acolytes learned their craft there as cultists tested the plague on the Barov household servants.

angles.text: As a Mage, you see Scholomance's lessons as a perversion of arcane scholarship. Magical inquiry has given way to rot, shadow, and unholy desecration.
As Forsaken, you may regard Scholomance with cold familiarity and disgust. Many Scourge methods of enslavement and biological warfare were perfected in its classrooms.
